greeting: Pull up a stool, {player}. The neon is free, the drinks are not.
Evening, {player}. Rough day or good night?
Welcome back. Same face, new story?
Sit. Listen. Drink. In whatever order suits you.
The glass is clean and the rumours are fresh, {player}.
You look like someone who earned a drink.
farewell: Mind the door on your way out.
Come back before the neon dims.
Leave a tip in the form of a good story.
The stool will keep your shape.
bark: Somebody keep the music up, the silence is getting ideas.
That booth has been arguing with itself since noon.
Nobody orders water here. Nobody ever has.
If the lights flicker, it is the grid. Probably.
I water nothing down. Ask the regulars. Ask the regulars' liver.
Last call is a state of mind.
Careful, the floor is sticky and the ceiling is listening.
A good bar remembers faces and forgets names.
rumour: They say a courier lost a case of chrome in the Watson stalls and the case is still looking for him.
A crew in the Badlands is selling maps that change every time you read them.
Somebody in the tower district has been paying double for quiet. Nobody knows who is selling it.
The pier at Pacifica glows green on certain nights. The fishermen stopped asking why.
There is a turret on the north docks that waves at the cargo ships. It has never shot one.
A ripperdoc downtown swears she can fit a second heart in under an hour. She also swears by her cat.
Overheard: a Maelstrom crew lost a bet and a van in the same evening.
The trams run late whenever a netrunner sneezes. At least that is the story at the depot.
A vending machine in Heywood gives change in a currency nobody has heard of.
The roof of the Japantown steps is the best seat in the city and the worst kept secret.
If you hear singing from the old yard, do not answer it. Even if the song is good.
Word is a fixer is paying in spare parts again. Smart ones ask for the eddies up front.
Someone painted a staircase on the side of a tower. Three people have tried to climb it.
A drone hovered over this bar all night. It ordered nothing.
drink: One {drink}, cold and sharp. Mind the aftertaste.
A {drink}. It works for about as long as the story does.
{drink}, as ordered. No refunds on bravery.
Here, a {drink}. It hits harder on an honest day.
no_funds: Your pockets are a little light for that one, {player}.
That is {price} eddies. I take cash, not hope.
Come back with {price} and I will pour it with a flourish.
